description: Use this when the user wants to find, compare, or filter Amazon FBA prep centers by name, US state, country, operator type, hazmat capability, or sales-tax-free location. Returns editorially verified centers with the date each was last verified and a link to its full profile. Do not use this for general Amazon FBA policy questions, FBA fee calculations, or for finding Amazon fulfillment centers.

country.description: Country code. Defaults to all countries.

hazmat_confirmed_only.description: Only centers we have positively confirmed accept hazmat. Most records are unconfirmed rather than negative, so this narrows results sharply.

operator_type.description: prep_specialist is prep only, multi_service adds adjacent services, full_3pl is a full fulfillment provider. Small Amazon-only sellers usually want prep_specialist.

q.description: Case-insensitive name search. Use this when the user names a specific prep center, for example 'Urva'. Matches anywhere in the center name.

state.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code the user explicitly named, for example 'TX'. Do not infer this from the user's location.

tax_free_state_only.description: Only centers in US sales-tax-free states (NH, OR, DE, MT, AK).

name: search_prep_centers
title: Search verified FBA prep centers
